text:
Alex B: hey team :wave: we just got a new tenant in ap-southeast2 and need a quick account network + GPU quota plan. goal is prod-ready VPC with NAT egress, PrivateLink to our S3 proxy, and a small dedicated A100 pool + burst capacity. who can help raise quotas?
Mira K: i can drive the cloud requests. can you paste the subnet/CIDR and planned instance types? also need current quota outputs.
Alex B: plan below — single AZ initially, add multi-AZ later.
Alex B: ```
VPC: 10.60.0.0/20
private subnets: 10.60.0.0/22 (worker), 10.60.4.0/24 (infra)
public NAT subnet: 10.60.8.0/26
expected nodes: 3 x a100-80gb (dedicated), 6 x t3.medium for infra
expected peak concurrent NAT connections: ~6k
```
Samir R: NAT EIP quota might be a pain in that region. default EIP per account is low in this cloud. also ENI (elastic network interfaces) limits could block ENI-per-pod setups.
Mira K: please run quotas command and paste. quota-bot: run `cloudctl compute quotas --region ap-southeast2 --account tenant-123` to fetch.
Alex B: ran it, output pasted below.
Alex B: ```
quota-bot: quotas for tenant-123 (ap-southeast2)
GPUs (A100): limit 0, used 0
On-demand vCPUs: limit 128, used 18
Elastic IPs: limit 5, used 2
ENIs: limit 60, used 10
NAT gateway concurrent connections: limit 2500, used 120
```
Mira K: ok need requests for A100 quota (+3), EIP (+10), ENI (+100), and NAT conn (+4000). i'll open tickets but want the justification wording. Alex can you draft cost/usage justification and expected timeline?
Alex B: Draft: "New tenant will run 3 dedicated A100 nodes for latency-sensitive inference. We require EIP pool for NAT HA across failover plans and increased ENIs to support our CNI + ENI-based pod networking. NAT concurrent connections will rise with steady traffic; without increase we see connection drops and degraded performance."
Samir R: add fallback plan: enable transient burst to shared hosted pool if quota delayed. we should also request temporary quota with expedited review.
Mira K: good. i'll create 4 tickets: GPUs, EIPs, ENIs, NAT conn. will mark GPUs as high priority and link to our SOC/arch signoff. also cc billing for reserved capacity estimate.
Infra Oncall: note for infra team: if GPUs are delayed >72h, we'll route inference traffic to eu-west1 shared pool (latency + cost impact). set autoscale policy to reduce preemptible risk.
Alex B: cost note for billing: 3 x a100-80gb dedicated (reserved monthly) ~ $24k/mo; fallback to hosted burst estimated additional $8-12k/mo depending on utilization — please confirm with finance.
Mira K: pushing the tickets now. draft for GPU quota: "Request increase A100 quota to 3 in ap-southeast2 for tenant-123. Purpose: dedicated inference nodes for initial prod. Timeline: need within 3 business days. Contact: mira@redwood.ai"
quota-bot: ticket created: CLOUD-78912 (A100), CLOUD-78913 (EIP), CLOUD-78914 (ENI), CLOUD-78915 (NAT). estimated review SLA: 48-96h for GPUs.
Samir R: while waiting i recommend we pre-create route tables and infra terraform with variables pointing to quotas, so we can apply as soon as quotas land. also set NAT gateway autoscaling policy to add additional t3s and adjust conn tracking: `sysctl net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=131072` on NAT instances.
Alex B: good call. i'll add terra code and open a PR against infra repo. snippet: ```hcl
module \"nat\" {
  source = \"git::ssh://git@github.com/redwood/infra-modules.git//nat\"
  eip_count = var.eip_count
  instance_type = var.nat_instance_type
}
```
Mira K: thanks. once CLOUD-78912 is approved i'll tag infra-oncall to schedule maintenance window for IP allocations and route attachment.
Infra Oncall: i'll monitor. pls add runbook check: verify SNAT table size, conntrack, and iptables rules before cutover. also add an alert if NAT conn > 70% of quota.
Alex B: will do. Mira, can you paste ticket links when they go live?
Mira K: done — links posted in tickets. will update status here. :thumbsup: 
Samir R: quick question — are we using PrivateLink for S3 proxy or VPC endpoint? PrivateLink avoids EIPs for that path and reduces nat egress.
Alex B: yes we prefer PrivateLink to S3 proxy; ticket also requests interface endpoint limits increase (eni-related). we should add that to CLOUD-78914.
Mira K: added note. final ask: if anyone knows regional constraints for ap-southeast2 on A100 availability (stock) pls chime in.
Samir R: i've seen sporadic shortages; ops can try capacity reservations or small multi-region split if stock tight.
Alex B: thanks all. i'll follow up with PR + runbook and mark this thread solved when quotas verified and infra applied.
